scope: One training bundle per configuration; 100 paired held-out initial seeds; no demonstrated necessity of future prediction

configuration.checkpoint_rule: All four new configurations use member epoch 30 and comparison epoch 40; legacy remains immutable
configuration.test_feedback: No model, protocol, sample size or candidate changes after the frozen test starts

physical_budget.scope: All trace sample/slot dimensions checked; true task termination remains in outcome/validity records; padding never enters success denominator

resources.gpu_scope: Whole-card 10-second sampling, not a continuous process-specific peak; post-evaluation score replay excluded

limitations: NoFutureLoss-G retains training-set future residual scale statistics
Full-G/NoFutureLoss-G differ only in future losses; SA-Critic also changes representation
Original 28 training episodes contain few informative anchors
The same seed is the statistical unit; decisions/ensemble members are not independent trials
No test feedback used to change methods, sample size or success criteria
Late legacy continuation lacks perception-cache replay; 0.2s future image targets precede this omission, but downstream outcome-label impact is unmeasured; see M1 pre-test data-quality note
NoFutureLoss-G retains train-only future residual statistics; SA-Critic excludes future images and their statistics
The 40-calibration best fixed index is an estimate, not the sealed-test hindsight-best candidate
Real-time deployment has not been demonstrated by these batched simulation timings
